rationale.scope: Model vocabulary only. g2p owns pronunciation and segmentation. Acoustic narrowing, recording-specific stress and prosody supervision remain separate training steps.
rationale.base_vocab: Frozen tokenizer get_vocab(), not raw vocab.json: the tokenizer adds |. All specials remain accepted because the old validator accepted them. Unknown phones must not silently become <unk> during training.

vocab_extensions.principle: The xls-r-2b backbone was pretrained on raw audio, not IPA; new CTC rows learn from scratch. Keep real contrasts instead of collapsing them to fit the borrowed inventory.
vocab_extensions.deu: ʏ distinguishes short ü from long y; eSpeak 1.52.0 conflated them, corrected by fork 9cbfd389.
vocab_extensions.dan: ʌː is real length; ɐ̯ is the non-syllabic falling-diphthong offglide (air, fjord), with U+032F folded onto the vowel.
vocab_extensions.ara: ʒː is a real long consonant, kept symmetrically even though rare.
vocab_extensions.ita: sː/zː/ʃː encode contrastive gemination (cassa versus casa). d̪/n̪ preserve dental place alongside existing t̪.
vocab_extensions.por: ʊ̃/ɪ̃ are phonemic nasal vowels, alongside existing ɔ̃ (mãe, bom illustrate the contrast).
vocab_extensions.rus: ɫʲ/ʃʲ encode soft л and щ. Folding ʲ onto consonants preserves phonemic palatalization rather than collapsing it.
vocab_extensions.merged: g2p 0.4.0 merges diphthongs, r-coloured vowels and affricates because brief split offglides were lost to CTC blank. Most merged units already existed; dz (Italian zio), õɪ̃/ũɪ̃ (Portuguese põe/muito), and ɐ̃j (mãe) needed extensions. Keep g2p's exact decomposed spellings.
vocab_extensions.narrowing: Nasalized ə̃/ʌ̃/æ̃/ɨ̃/ɯ̃/ɒ̃/ø̃ and long-vowel nasal forms admit the separate narrowing pipeline's labels. The current acoustic/carry-over choices are selective, not uniform before-coda replacements. Preprocessing does not generate these from oral vowels. Decomposed base + optional length + U+0303 matches the inventory and supports Panphon articulatory features.
vocab_extensions.tha: tɕʰ/uə/ɯə/əː/ɯː preserve TLTK/Vachana aspiration, length and quality contrasts. Tone stays in a separate aligned field.
vocab_extensions.zho-hans: The g2pM/pinyin inventory preserves ɤ, retroflex affricates, syllabic apicals, tsʰ, ɥ and falling diphthongs as single CTC units. Citation tone letters go into the separate tone field.
vocab_extensions.jpn: OpenJTalk surface phones include devoiced high vowels ɯ̥ᵝ/i̥, palatalized ɾʲ, and geminates derived from moraic closure cl.
vocab_extensions.hin: The schwa-classifier inventory preserves contrastive aspiration, breathy voice, retroflexion and dental place, including tied affricates. Surface-weight rules supply stress separately.
vocab_extensions.kor: g2pk2 supplies tense k͈/t͈/p͈/tɕ͈/s͈. The lenis/aspirated/tense contrast is phonemic (달/탈/딸); lenis and aspirated tokens already exist.
